capabilities: Manage Kanban boards stored as Markdown notes
Drag cards between columns and reorder them
Add comments, history and card relationships
extras: Desktop only; phones and tablets are not supported. Agent access and agents in columns are off by default; agents in columns is experimental and macOS/Linux only. The plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Kanban board, so cards and their status, comments and history have to be managed as separate Markdown notes by hand.

relations.evidence: By default that is a Claude Code session in a window of the plugin's own tmux server

summary: Kanban board plugin where every card is a plain Markdown file, with drag-and-drop columns, nested subcards, comments, history, search and optional agent access.
